name: Aigües (Spain)
description: Vairy of white and black within a narrow white border, in the proportions 2:3.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council of Aigües on 30 July 2010 and by the Generalitat Valenciana by resolution of 15 February 2011, published in the DOGV of 21 February 2011; it is described as tercejada al pal, vairy of pearl grey and black, framed by a pearl-grey stripe.

features.role: vair pattern (vairy of white and black)
